title: Finance English Quiz Pack
instructions: Read the question, then write the best answer in your own words.

questions.question: What does revenue mean in finance English?
questions.answer: income generated by selling goods or services
questions.example_sentence: We delivered over $245 billion in annual revenue, up 16 percent year-over-year, and over $109 billion in operating income, up 24 percent.

questions.question: What does operating mean in finance English?
questions.answer: related to the day-to-day running of a business
questions.example_sentence: We delivered over $245 billion in annual revenue, up 16 percent year-over-year, and over $109 billion in operating income, up 24 percent.

questions.question: What does growth mean in finance English?
questions.answer: an increase in size, sales, value, or performance
questions.example_sentence: These are long-term assets to drive new growth for the next decade and beyond, and ensure communities around the world have access to the compute they need to drive economic growth in this new era.

questions.question: What does technology mean in finance English?
questions.answer: scientific or digital tools used to create value
questions.example_sentence: We were founded in 1975 with a belief in creating technology that would enable others to create their own.

questions.question: What does product mean in finance English?
questions.answer: an item or service offered to customers
questions.example_sentence: Unilever is performing thousands of simulations with AI in the time it would take to run tens of laboratory experiments, as it accelerates its product development.

questions.question: What does customer mean in finance English?
questions.answer: a person or organization that buys goods or services
questions.example_sentence: Our new Dynamics 365 Contact Center infuses generative AI throughout the contact center workflow in a customer’s existing CRM.

questions.question: What does expense mean in finance English?
questions.answer: a cost incurred in running a business
questions.example_sentence: Research and Development Research and development expenses include payroll, employee benefits, stock-based compensation expense, and other headcount-related expenses associated with product development.

questions.question: What does platform mean in finance English?
questions.answer: a technology system or foundation that supports products or services
questions.example_sentence: We entered our 50th year as a company and the second year of the AI platform shift.

questions.question: What does market mean in finance English?
questions.answer: a group of customers or the business environment in which companies compete
questions.example_sentence: And we are expanding our total addressable market by integrating Copilot into third-party systems as well.

questions.question: What does acquisition mean in finance English?
questions.answer: the purchase of one company by another
questions.example_sentence: With our acquisition of Activision Blizzard King, which closed October 2023, we’ve added hundreds of millions of players to our ecosystem.

questions.question: What does industry mean in finance English?
questions.answer: a branch of economic activity or business sector
questions.example_sentence: With these milestones, I’ve found myself reflecting on how Microsoft has remained a consequential company decade after decade in an industry with no franchise value.

questions.question: What does investment mean in finance English?
questions.answer: money put into something in order to earn future returns

questions.answer: the difference between revenue and costs, often shown as a percentage

questions.question: What does partner mean in finance English?
questions.answer: a business or person working together with another organization
questions.example_sentence: We continue to partner with diverse-owned banking partners and asset managers to catalyze growth and industry participation.

questions.question: What does capital mean in finance English?
questions.answer: money or resources used to finance operations or growth
questions.example_sentence: These commitments drive sustained impact by directly enabling an increase of funds into local communities, improving diverse, small-business access to capital, and increasing skill development.

questions.question: What does valuation mean in finance English?
questions.answer: an estimate of how much a company is worth

questions.answer: a chance to achieve something beneficial
questions.example_sentence: And I realize that it’s because—time and time again, when tech paradigms have shifted—we have seized the opportunity to reinvent ourselves to stay relevant to our customers, our partners, and our employees.

questions.question: What does asset mean in finance English?
questions.answer: something valuable that a company owns
